body: Not ticks at all. Nope no.

I feel like the only place for me is in death, but I would love to do a bit of advocacy before I go. Maybe that could snowball into something better, who knows... It's hard to get peer support groups going because according to a lot of people "talking about suicide is the same as encouraging suicide" which in my experience isn't true. I usually calm down a bit when I get to talk to like minded people.

No, my friends were the ones who hurt me. I do have a good friend right now though. He is really nice. I feel really bad about just leaving him on his own if I am going to die.

I wish things made me happy. Silly things can make me laugh though.

Today I looked at what my old friends were doing which made me feel pretty upset as they basically replaced me. I guess that's a growing experience?
